_note: Recipes for generated character sheets. Every piece under Character Pieces/ is a full 1792x704 sheet in the same rig the atlas reads, so a character is those layers alpha-composited: skin, eyes, clothes, hair, hat. `npm run characters` writes assets/generated/characters/<id>.png. The two original farmers were exported by hand and are NOT listed here — regenerating them would overwrite art that already ships. Everything new goes through this file, so adding a class is five strings instead of a trip through a generator UI.
_layerOrder: body -> eyes -> outfit -> hair -> accessory. Any other order puts a hat under a fringe.
